ayce.en: AYCE hot pot is $28.99 per adult, with a soup base included. Choose AAA beef, lamb, pork or chicken; order meat through your server. Each guest has an individual pot.
ayce.zh: 火鍋自助每位成人 $28.99，已含湯底。一人一鍋，牛、羊、豬及雞肉可向店員加點。

snacks.en: Add 19 all-you-can-eat snacks to AYCE for $5.99 per person. Everyone at the same table must take the snack upgrade.
snacks.zh: 火鍋自助每位加 $5.99，可享19款小吃任食；同桌須一起升級。

personal.en: The $19.99 personal hot pot includes 1 soup base, a large vegetable set, 1 meat and 1 rice or noodle side.
personal.zh: 個人火鍋 $19.99，包含1份湯底、大份蔬菜盤、1份肉類及1份飯或麵。

combos.en: Solo Combo: 1 personal hot pot and 1 drink for $24.99. Couple Combo: 2 personal hot pots, 2 drinks and 1 appetizer for $58.99.
combos.zh: 單人套餐 $24.99，包含1份個人火鍋及1杯飲品。雙人套餐 $58.99，包含2份個人火鍋、2杯飲品及1份小吃。

soups.en: Choose from 15 soup bases: Chicken & Spicy Pot, Spicy, Sukiyaki, Tom Yum Kung, Chinese Herbs, Chicken Soup, Pork Soup, Sesame Oil, Pickled Cabbage, Curry, Satay, Kimchi, Milk, Miso, Tomato. For ingredient or dietary questions, please check with staff.
soups.zh: 共有15款湯底可選，包括壽喜燒、冬陰功、麻辣、番茄及味噌。完整選項請看菜單；食材或飲食限制請先向店員確認。

kids.en: AYCE children’s prices are based on height: under 100 cm free; 100–140 cm $12.99; over 140 cm adult price.
kids.zh: 火鍋自助兒童收費按身高：100厘米以下免費；100至140厘米 $12.99；超過140厘米按成人收費。

hours.en: Monday–Friday: 5:00–10:30 PM. Saturday–Sunday: noon–10:30 PM. All times are Calgary local time. For holiday changes, please check with the restaurant.
hours.zh: 週一至週五：下午5時至晚上10時30分。週六、週日：中午12時至晚上10時30分。均為卡加利當地時間；假期安排請向餐廳確認。

location.en: 2213 Centre St N #2243, Calgary, AB T2E 2T4. Call (403) 455-3188 for restaurant questions.
location.zh: 2213 Centre St N #2243, Calgary, AB T2E 2T4。餐廳查詢請致電 (403) 455-3188。

booking.en: Use Book Online to choose your date, party size and available time. This assistant cannot check live tables or make a reservation. A pending request still needs restaurant approval; only the booking system can show a confirmed reservation. For large groups or urgent changes, call (403) 455-3188.
booking.zh: 請按「網上訂位」選擇日期、人數及可用時段。本助手不能查詢即時空位或代為訂位。待確認申請仍需餐廳批准；請以訂位系統的確認結果為準。大型聚餐或緊急更改請致電 (403) 455-3188。

dietary.en: Please ask restaurant staff about allergies, ingredients, vegetarian options or other dietary needs before ordering. This assistant cannot verify allergen safety, cross-contact, halal status or special preparation. Call (403) 455-3188.
dietary.zh: 過敏、食材、素食或其他飲食要求，請於點餐前向店員確認。本助手不能保證過敏原安全、無交叉接觸、清真認證或特殊烹調安排。請致電 (403) 455-3188。

staff.en: I can help with the published menu, prices, location, hours and booking steps. For anything else, please call the restaurant at (403) 455-3188.
staff.zh: 我可以協助查閱菜單、價格、地址、營業時間及訂位步驟。其他問題請致電餐廳 (403) 455-3188。

rice_noodles.en: Rice and noodles: Signature Taiwanese Beef Noodle Soup $16.99; Braised Pork Rice $12.99; Taiwanese Fried Chicken Or Cutlet Rice / Noodle $14.99; Wonton Soup with Rice / Noodle $14.99; Unagi Rice Bowl $18.99; Beef Brisket Rice $16.99; Sukiyaki Beef Rice $16.99. Prices in CAD. See the menu for all options; order through your server.
rice_noodles.zh: 飯麵類：招牌台灣牛肉麵 $16.99; 滷肉飯 $12.99; 台式炸雞或雞排飯／麵 $14.99; 雲吞湯配飯／麵 $14.99; 鰻魚飯 $18.99; 牛腩飯 $16.99; 壽喜燒牛肉飯 $16.99。價格為加元。完整選項請看菜單；點餐請向店員提出。

appetizers.en: Selected à la carte snacks: Signature Taiwanese Fried Chicken $9.89; Takoyaki (6pcs) $8.89; Crispy Chicken Cutlet $9.89; Golden Fried Buns $6.89; Crispy Squid Legs $9.89; Popcorn Chicken $6.89; Golden Onion Rings $6.49; Edamame $6.49. Prices in CAD. See the menu for all options; order through your server.
appetizers.zh: 部分單點小吃：招牌台式炸雞 $9.89; 章魚燒 $8.89; 香脆雞排 $9.89; 黃金炸饅頭 $6.89; 酥炸魷魚鬚 $9.89; 鹽酥雞 $6.89; 黃金洋蔥圈 $6.49; 毛豆 $6.49。價格為加元。完整選項請看菜單；點餐請向店員提出。

drinks.en: Drink categories: Classic Teas $4.95; Milk Teas $5.95; Sea Salt Cream $6.95; Smoothies $7.95; Specialty Sodas $6.95; Soft Drinks $2.00. Prices in CAD. See the menu for all options; order through your server.
drinks.zh: 飲品類別：經典茶飲 $4.95; 奶茶 $5.95; 海鹽奶蓋 $6.95; 冰沙 $7.95; 特調汽水 $6.95; 汽水 $2.00。價格為加元。完整選項請看菜單；點餐請向店員提出。

addons.en: Personal hot pot add-ons: Split Pot Upgrade $2.00; Extra Meat $3.69; Extra Rice or Noodle Side $2.00. Prices in CAD. See the menu for all options; order through your server.
addons.zh: 個人火鍋加點：鴛鴦鍋升級 $2.00; 加肉 $3.69; 加飯或麵 $2.00。價格為加元。完整選項請看菜單；點餐請向店員提出。
